headline: China's labour ministry has set out an action plan to protect jobs as AI spreads, MLex reports.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: the same ministry announcement our 10 Oct edition carried, with only MLex's headline and standfirst available.
importance_line: What changed: Beijing's labour ministry has outlined training and jobs support as AI spreads, which matters first to Chinese workers, students and employers, then to firms using AI, but the available text gives no budget, scale or start date.
summary: MLex reports that China's Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security outlined an action plan on Saturday 10 Oct 2026, the announcement our 10 Oct edition carried from Global Times, to promote employment as AI develops, with training for workers, people in specialised roles, students and the public.
notes: MLex is paywalled; headline and page standfirst only. Same announcement as item 96 of our 10 Oct edition (Global Times); candidate for the 14-day duplicate check, though MLex adds the training detail.
